- Norwegian Bible Supports for iPhone/iPod Touch and iPad 
- Swipe the Verse to Bookmark and Share from Norwegian Bible
- Easy and Quick Navigation 
- An swape access to bookmark and back to other chapters with Norwegian Bible verses. 
- Support for sharing the Norwegian Bible in social media (Facebook, Twitter, Whatsapp) 
- Sharing your daily content of Norwegian bible with E-Mail and SMS 
- Full text search 
- Ability to add, edit and delete notes. 
- Read easier with settings like text size, fonts, text color and background color.
